d:
Expedition X ventures into cursed ruins, abandoned bunkers, and legendary haunted places where science collides with the unknown. From stepping inside a chilling haunted house after dark to surviving overnight lockdowns with unexplained shadows, relive the most bone-chilling evidence and supernatural breakthroughs that left the investigators stunned.
Watch Expedition X on Discovery Channel India Season 2 (Episodes 2, 3, 4, 9 & 13) & Season 3 (Episodes 2, 3, 4, 6, 7 & 8).
